posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: There has been no greater President that stands with American Farmers and Ranchers than President Donald J. Trump! As l've stated before, I was the last President to get a Farm Bill done in 2018. IT IS TIME TO DO IT AGAIN, and FAST. Our Great Farmers and Ranchers NEED and DESERVE certainty ahead of the 2027 planting season because FOOD SECURITY IS NATIONAL SECURITY! Congressional Republican Majorities, YOU MUST PASS A NEW FARM BILL DURING THE REMAINING DAYS OF CONGRESS. FARMERS AND RANCHERS ARE NOT INTERESTED IN FURTHER DELAYS. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. T

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Anthropic shares will begin publicly trading today in a market debut that may test the strength of the AI boom.

Anthropic will release more shares than initially planned and raised the price, indicating strong interest from investors.
posts.text_ko:
Anthropic 주식은 AI 붐의 힘을 시험할 수 있는 시장 데뷔로 오늘부터 공개 거래를 시작할 것입니다.

앤트로픽은 당초 계획보다 더 많은 주식을 발행하고 가격도 인상할 예정이어서 투자자들의 높은 관심을 엿볼 수 있다.

posts.name: The Associated Press
posts.text: Matas Buzelis scored a season-high 25 points, Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists, and the Chicago Bulls rolled to their easiest victory of the season by beating the Brooklyn Nets 137-107.
posts.text_ko: Matas Buzelis는 시즌 최다인 25득점을 기록했고 Josh Giddey는 18득점, 14리바운드, 9어시스트를 기록했으며 Chicago Bulls는 Brooklyn Nets를 137-107로 꺾고 시즌 가장 쉬운 승리를 거두었습니다.
